accounting_change: The earlier all-or-nothing phase-exit indicator was 40%. The same six phase weights and full scope now receive explicit partial milestone credit. This is a catch-up remeasurement of delivered work, not a new 21-point implementation in this turn.
method: Within phases 3–6, each named requirement package has equal weight. Nested accepted GUI families have equal family weight, then equal declared intent/task weight within that family. Verified-source leaves score 1, pending leaves score 0; parents average children. Supplemental defect/test/issue counts add no bonus. Pending means not accepted by this audit, not absent code.
gui_scope: Tracking packages make the previously accepted workflow inventory explicit. They are user intents, not a GUI promise for every expert argument or a new scientific feature request. Native/expert APIs remain available and retain their own qualification.
publication: The existing pause remains. #640/#641/#642 and all other required correctness work retain owning acceptance. Exact candidate/platform/installed and final sign-off gates are not scored as passed by source tests.
